answer: Conserved sponsorship quotas give each independently vetted sponsor a fixed claim budget per epoch. A verifier debits that budget for every sponsored claim; forwarding quota never creates more. Routing claims through oasis, haven or meadow therefore cannot enlarge one sponsor's total rewards. An attacker needs additional sponsors' scarce quota for additional claims, obtained by persuasion or purchase. This assumes sponsor vetting resists duplicates and reward rules offer no per-account bonuses.
